title: Continuous cochains preserve short exact sequences of discrete modules
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ a short exact sequence in the abelian category of left $A$-modules with continuous $A$-linear $G$-action [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Give these modules the discrete topology. For every $n\geq0$, the sequence $0\to\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,M')\to\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,M)\to\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,M'')\to0$ is exact. The maps commute with the inhomogeneous group-cochain differentials, namely $d^0m(g)=gm-m$ and, for $n\geq1$, $d^nf(g_1,\ldots,g_{n+1})=g_1f(g_2,\ldots,g_{n+1})+\sum_{j=1}^n(-1)^jf(g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{n+1})+(-1)^{n+1}f(g_1,\ldots,g_n)$; hence they form a short exact sequence of cochain complexes of $A$-modules.

proof.text: Use the proved abelian-structure and underlying-module exactness theorem [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian-structure], without its sibling's enough-injectives assertion. The forgetful functor preserves finite limits and colimits, hence monos and epis. Postcomposition with the injection is injective pointwise. For a cochain killed by the surjection choose a preimage of each value in the coefficient kernel, extend this choice by zero outside the kernel, and postcompose; the choice is continuous between discrete spaces. For surjectivity, postcompose with a set-theoretic right inverse of the coefficient surjection, again continuous between discrete spaces. These arguments include degree zero.

proof.text: Construct the continuous A-linear differential by the displayed formula. The action term is continuous by the open-stabilizer criterion for a discrete action, and every other term is a continuous precomposition followed by multiplication by an integer. To prove square-zero, forget to the integer-linear representation, lift the integers, group, and coefficient carrier to their common universe, and compare pointwise with Mathlib's inhomogeneousCochains.d. Fin.contractNth commutes with taking ULift.down. Apply groupCohomology.inhomogeneousCochains.d_comp_d and evaluate at lifts of the original arguments. This proves square-zero in all degrees, including zero.

proof.text: Postcomposition with either equivariant A-linear coefficient map commutes with the action term by equivariance, and with the signed sum by additivity and preservation of integer multiples. Thus the explicit cochain maps commute with the differentials; their composite is zero by the coefficient short-complex relation. Apply the degreewise short-exactness criterion [lem-weil-pbc-cochain-complexes-degreewise-exact] directly for the shape up Nat, using the pointwise injectivity, kernel-image equality and surjectivity from step 1. Identity linear coordinates give precisely the required formulas. No extension to integer degrees is needed.
